Hi team (+ Samantha),

Thanks again to everyone who joined Friday’s micro-workshop. We had ~420 registrants, ~160 live attendees, and roughly 120 attendees who watched the session in full. Samantha — really appreciate Orchid’s participation and the great questions.

Attached is the cleaned attendee export (attendee_export_20281120.csv). I ran a quick enrichment and scored engagement with the following short rules: 1) Live join + Q&A = high (score >= 80), 2) Live join only = mid (50–79), 3) Registered but no join = low (<50). Please use these tags when claiming in HubSpot.

Asks / plan (short):
- SDR triage window: claim hot accounts within 48 hours (deadline: Wed 11/22 09:00 PT). Hot = engagement >= 80 or company >50 employees + product-fit signal.
- Warm list: personalized nurture + 1-touch from SDR within 5 business days.
- Cold/reg list: send on-demand recording drip (we’ll run a 2-email nurture).
- Concierge booking: concierge_booking_links.pdf includes shortlinks to schedule a 15m intro/demo (prefer SDR-owned links).
- Recording: share Zoom recording link only after hot/warm claim window closes (see Drive link).

Routing details:
- HubSpot event code: EVT-MW-1128. I added a property in the CSV (hubspot_event_code). When you claim, update Lifecycle Stage -> MQL if the account matches our MQL criteria; otherwise mark as Marketing Qualified Lead (nurture).
- If you see any enterprise accounts with procurement questions, flag me and Marissa.

Samantha — we’ll prioritize Orchid Analytics as a hot account (you had strong Q&A around inference latency). Ben will reach out to schedule a concierge session and share a Mutual Action Plan template.

Notes: I placed a draft MAP in the Drive folder and also attached the template for quick edits.

Thanks — Mina

Marissa — good call. Use event-specific relaxation: treat engagement >=75 as hot for this program (we promoted targeted content and had a tight-fit audience). Still require ACV signal for immediate AE handoff; if ACV unknown, SDR should open a qualification and mark as MQL pending revenue confirmation.

Warm list: yes — 2-touch cadence (email + call) before moving to nurture. I put a short script in the Drive folder (link below). Please ask SDRs to add a one-line outcome in the HubSpot event notes after outreach (Claimed / Left VM / No Interest).

I also reconciled duplicates and appended a small "internal_priority" column in the CSV — Ben, you can filter by that for your initial claims.

HubSpot event view: https://hubspot.com/contacts/CRM-298712-event-sessions
Drive folder (MAP + scripts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_microworkshop

Thanks — Mina
